description: "History of the United Netherlands, 1586" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account that was probably written during the late 19th century. This book chronicles the tumultuous period of the Dutch struggle for independence from Spanish rule, specifically focusing on the events following the death of William the Silent and leading up to the Twelve Years' Truce in 1609.
